title: Introduction to AI and Machine Learning Winter School
field: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, large language models
about: Two-week, 3 ECTS on-campus winter school course at Aalto University introducing AI and machine learning with a focus on large language models, 18-29 January 2027. Applications for Winter School 2027 run 15 September-15 November 2026.
requirements: Motivation letter (150-250 words) or video (1-2 minutes) required
3 ECTS, total workload 81 h, on campus over two weeks (18-29 January 2027)

upskill.name: Large Language Model Fundamentals
why: "Artificial intelligence, machine learning, large language models" (field) → "Understand Transformers, attention mechanisms, tokens, embeddings, context windows, and the core architectural foundations that enable modern large language models."

"Large language models" (skill) → "Explore how large language models are pretrained on large-scale data, instruction-tuned for downstream tasks, and aligned to better follow human intentions and application requirements."
